# metamcp_endpoint (Resource)

Manages a MetaMCP endpoint: the URL an MCP client connects to, publishing one namespace's servers behind an auth mode.

A namespace holds the servers; an endpoint exposes them. Create the namespace first and reference its `uuid` here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "metamcp_namespace" "tools" {
  name = "tools"
}

# An endpoint is the URL MCP clients actually connect to. It publishes one
# namespace, so reference that namespace's uuid.
resource "metamcp_endpoint" "tools" {
  name           = "tools"
  namespace_uuid = metamcp_namespace.tools.uuid
  description    = "Internal tooling endpoint"

  enable_api_key_auth = true
  enable_oauth        = false
}

output "mcp_url" {
  value = metamcp_endpoint.tools.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `namespace_uuid` (String) UUID of the namespace this endpoint publishes.

### Optional

- `create_mcp_server` (Boolean) Create a MetaMCP server for this endpoint. Only meaningful at creation; the API ignores it on update.
- `description` (String)
- `enable_api_key_auth` (Boolean) Allow MCP API keys to authenticate. Defaults to `true`.
- `enable_oauth` (Boolean) Allow OAuth authentication. Defaults to `false`.
- `use_query_param_auth` (Boolean) Accept the credential as a query parameter instead of a header.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url` (String) The MCP URL clients connect to, derived from the endpoint's name.
- `uuid` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the endpoint UUID, not its name.
terraform import metamcp_endpoint.tools b5c7e9a1-3d2f-4b6c-8e0a-1f4d7b9c2e53
```
